evidence.notes: Covers the local supported flag subset: CASE_INSENSITIVE, MULTILINE, DOTALL, UNICODE_CASE as a no-op companion, LITERAL, and supported inline i/m/s flags.
Pattern.pattern returns the original source even when Pattern.LITERAL compiles through a quoted local regex.
Find honors compiled local flag state carried from Pattern.compile(regex, flags).
Matches honors inline case-insensitive flags in the supported local regex subset.
Group returns matches from flagged and literal Pattern sources.
usePattern swaps to another compiled local Pattern after a flagged/literal source.
